name: Angurbala Parida

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Angurbala Parida is an Odia poet associated with Rourkela. Sahitya Akademi records her participation in its Asmita programme for Odia women writers in Bhubaneswar on 17 July 2013, where she read Rabana and Balada. The event placed her work in a conversation about women’s experience, identity and the pressures of social life.

In Kabita Live’s ନାରୀ ପରି ମରୁଥାଏ ନଈ, the river and the woman mirror one another: both sustain life, endure restraint and face the loss of a name. ପ୍ରେମ ସରିବା ଦିନ widens the question of love into a landscape of violence and ruins. Against that devastation, the continuing flow of the Kathajodi and Mahanadi offers a counter-image.
